_comment: Change control for the two installable packages. The version in
plugins/socialized/.claude-plugin/plugin.json pins what an installed copy is, so a
changed distributable needs a deliberate version decision. tests/test_release_integrity.py
fails when a package's bytes no longer match the version recorded here.
Documentation-only edits change no package and need no bump.
After an intentional change: rebuild the packages, bump plugin_version, then run
